import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static long power(long a, long b) {
        long res = 1;
        a %= MOD;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) res = (res * a) % MOD;
            a = (a * a) % MOD;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int n;
    static final int N = 1 << 20;
    static int[] f_arr = new int[N];
    static int[] g_arr = new int[N];
    static int[][] p_table = new int[21][21];
    static int[] idx0 = new int[N];
    static int[] idx1 = new int[N];
    static int[] rev_arr = new int[N];
    static int[] matched_arr = new int[21];
    static int[][] adj_mat = new int[21][21];

    static void transform(int[] output, List<Integer> left_side, List<Integer> right_side,
                          List<Integer> subgraphs, int[] index_fn) {
        List<int[]> edge_list = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int u : left_side) {
            for (int v : right_side) {
                edge_list.add(new int[]{u, v});
            }
        }

        int edge_count = edge_list.size();
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << edge_count); ++mask) {
            long factor = 1;

            for (int i = 0; i < edge_count; ++i) {
                int u = edge_list.get(i)[0], v = edge_list.get(i)[1];
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    factor = (factor * p_table[u][v]) % MOD;
                    adj_mat[u][v] = 1;
                } else {
                    factor = (factor * ((1 - p_table[u][v] + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
                    adj_mat[u][v] = 0;
                }
            }

            int new_mask = 0;
            for (int gr : subgraphs) {
                List<Integer> L = new ArrayList<>(left_side);
                List<Integer> R = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                    if ((gr & (1 << i)) != 0) R.add(i + n);
                }
                Collections.sort(R);

                boolean found = false;
                Collections.sort(L);
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int i = 0; i < L.size(); ++i) {
                        if (adj_mat[L.get(i)][R.get(i)] == 0) { ok = false; break; }
                    }
                    if (ok) { found = true; break; }
                } while (nextPermutation(R));

                if (found) new_mask |= (1 << index_fn[gr]);
            }

            output[new_mask] = (int)((output[new_mask] + factor) % MOD);
        }
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> arr) {
        int i = arr.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && arr.get(i) >= arr.get(i + 1)) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        
        int j = arr.size() - 1;
        while (arr.get(j) <= arr.get(i)) j--;
        
        Collections.swap(arr, i, j);
        Collections.reverse(arr.subList(i + 1, arr.size()));
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        long inv100 = power(100, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                long x = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
                p_table[i][j + n] = (int)((x * inv100) % MOD);
            }
        }

        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(p_table[0][1]);
            return;
        }

        int half1 = n / 2;
        int half2 = n - half1;

        int cnt1 = 0, cnt2 = 0;
        List<Integer> S1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> S2 = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == half1) {
                idx0[mask] = cnt1;
                S1.add(mask);
                ++cnt1;
            }
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == half2) {
                idx1[mask] = cnt2;
                S2.add(mask);
                ++cnt2;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < cnt2; ++i) {
            int mask = S2.get(i);
            int comp = ((1 << n) - 1) ^ mask;
            rev_arr[i] = idx0[comp];
        }

        List<Integer> L1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> L2 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> R = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = n; i < 2 * n; ++i) R.add(i);
        for (int i = 0; i < half1; ++i) L1.add(i);
        for (int i = half1; i < n; ++i) L2.add(i);

        transform(f_arr, L1, R, S1, idx0);
        transform(g_arr, L2, R, S2, idx1);

        int size1 = 1 << cnt1;
        for (int i = 0; i < cnt1; ++i) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < size1; ++mask) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    f_arr[mask] = (int)((f_arr[mask] + f_arr[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD);
                }
            }
        }

        long final_ans = 0;
        int size2 = 1 << cnt2;
        for (int mask = 1; mask < size2; ++mask) {
            int complement = size2 - 1 - mask;
            int rev_mask = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < cnt2; ++i) {
                if ((complement & (1 << i)) != 0) rev_mask |= (1 << rev_arr[i]);
            }

            int inv = (size1 - 1) ^ rev_mask;
            long w = (1 - f_arr[inv] + MOD) % MOD;
            final_ans = (final_ans + w * g_arr[mask]) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(final_ans);
    }
}
